sectors.name: Renewables & Climate-Tech
themes: Indonesia's captive nickel and geothermal resource base gives local players like TOBA and TPIA structural cost advantage over global peers, insulating them from US rate cycles.
Government mandates for biodiesel blending and captive solar PPAs are creating a durable domestic demand floor for ID-listed climate-tech names, independent of global sentiment.
US clean-tech names (PLUG, CEG) remain hostage to IRA subsidy politics and high capital costs, making them tactical trades, not structural holds, for Indonesia-focused capital.
sectors.ai: Buy TOBA and TPIA on Indonesia's domestic energy-transition tailwind; US-listed PLUG/CEG are beta trades, not core. LAPD and PKPK add small-cap convexity on rural electrification and waste-to-energy mandates. Trim ARKO/1211 into strength. Stay long ID renewables, short US clean-tech until US policy clarity.

Structural shift toward food-away-from-home (NASI, CARS) and tech-enabled retail (NANO, BTEK) is accelerating, supported by rising urban middle-class spending and digital adoption.
sectors.ai: Buy selective small-cap FMCG names showing volume-driven re-rating (AGAR, BTEK, NAYZ) while large caps lag; US strength (+1.00%) supports export-linked consumer plays. Rotate into food-service and specialty retail sub-sectors with earnings momentum, avoid broad index exposure. Target 3-6 week horizon, set tight stops at 5% below entry given normal signal volatility.
